exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: писа́ть — to write; письмо — letter (written communication); писа́тель — writer; запи́ска — note, memo (memorandum).
**запись** — за́пись: record, recording (e.g. sound); entry (e.g. in a log, a journal, a database or a document); (historical) official act, record, deed, registration. Wiktionary: записа́ть + -ь.

exercises.why: **надпись** — на́дпись: inscription, writing, label; dedication (on a book); address (on an envelope); legend (on a coin, medal, map). Wiktionary: надписа́ть + -ь.
